text: (1) Scanned page of the first page of the passport (validity is later than March 31, 2026). Those who have stayed in China are required to provide all scanned copies of visas and residence permits related to China. (2) The original high school graduation certificate or a notarized copy is required. For current students, a pre-graduation certificate issued by the student's school (indicating the graduation date earlier than September 10, 2025) must be provided. During the registration and enrollment process, the original graduation certificate must be submitted. (3) Original copies or notarized versions of all course transcripts from the high school years; (4) Applicants for English-taught programs are required to provide copies of their IELTS, TOEFL or Duolingo test scores. The IELTS score must be above 5.5, the TOEFL score must be above 80, or the Duolingo score must be above 100. (5) Self-introduction: Submit a self-introduction document expressing your intention to study in China (no less than 800 words). The document can be written in either Chinese or English. The content should include your personal learning and work experiences, your motivation for studying in China, reasons for choosing a specific major, and your personal career goals after graduation. (6) Foreign Physical Examination Form: Applicants are required to undergo the examinations as per the items listed in the form. The validity period of the examination results is 6 months. (7) Financial Capacity Proof (One of the following documents: Family Deposit Certificate, Family Property Certificate, Parent/Guardian Income Certificate. It is recommended to be at least $5,000 or more.) (8) Criminal record certificate, valid for 6 months.
